ctx.x: It's 1917. Right. And then he said that they brought in...ah, a piano player from back East--Hageman.

And they brought him in as a pianist, and, uh, that was when Jelly Roll left and went to, he says, George Brown's place and took all the movie star trade... "By that time the Cadillac was sure I was the man so I took over half the business, went back in there..."
